sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.4093 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/Accused Nos. 1 to 6 under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in Crime No.608 of 2019 pending on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate (Junior Civil Judge), Allagadda registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273 and 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of FSS Act (Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006).

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate (Junior Civil Judge), Allagadda
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: FSS Act (Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this Criminal Petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.

The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.
__________________________________________ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date: 24.09.2020 IS THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION NO.4093 OF 2020 Date: 24.09.2020 IS Bhoganadhi Prasad, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 24 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164076346/
